At the master’s level, we offer the following degrees: Master of Engineering (Aerospace), Master of Engineering (Materials), Master of Engineering (Mechanical), Master of Engineering (Sustainable Energy), Master of Engineering (Biomedical) Master of Applied Science (Aerospace), Master of Applied Science (Materials) and a Master of Applied Science (Mechanical), Master of Applied Science (Sustainable Energy), Master of Applied Science (Biomedical)
Start your application here!
M.A.Sc. – Masters degree with thesis in:
Aerospace Engineering, Biomedical Engineering, Materials Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, and Sustainable Energy
M.Eng. – Master of Engineering degree (without thesis) in:
Biomedical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, and Sustainable Energy
There are two options available for the Master of Engineering (M.Eng.) degree:
Project Option – complete 7 courses plus a project, or
Courses Option – complete 10 courses
*We are currently not receiving new applications for Aerospace and Materials Engineering*
Ph.D. degrees in:
Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering and Biomedical Engineering.
These are offered as part of the Ottawa-Carleton Institute for Mechanical & Aerospace Engineering (OCIMAE), or in the case of the M.A.Sc. in Biomedical Engineering, as part of the Ottawa-Carleton Institute for Biomedical Engineering (OCIBME). These Institutes are joint between the relevant academic departments at Carleton University and the University of Ottawa. A major advantage of this Institute structure is to allow graduate students to register directly in relevant courses at either university for credit toward their degree program.
